task.ques: Find a French ratatouille recipe on Allrecipes with a 4-star rating or higher and at least 15 reviews. Note the variety of vegetables included and the overall cooking time.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Allrecipes’ “Ratatouille” by lynette qualifies with 4.6/5 stars and 798 reviews (1,128 ratings). This French vegetable stew includes eggplant, zucchini, tomatoes, fresh mushrooms, onion, green or red bell pepper, and garlic. The listed total time is 1 hour: 15 minutes prep and 45 minutes cooking.
Source: https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/18411/ratatouille/ (accessed October 27, 2026; recipe updated January 20, 2026).
Evidence: final.png shows the recipe name, rating, review count and French description together.
